limitations: Two fixed automated offline clients; no human, distinct-Folia-region, load, or network capacity acceptance.
Clean shutdown and two restarts; no forced JVM crash, hot reload or write failure injection on live servers.
Invalid contract message remains pending until recipient explicitly acknowledges it; no automatic dead-letter policy.
Contract timeout remains 200 logical server ticks; clocks run while players are offline or not joined.
Uses Java21 with 512 MiB maximum heap and a Java25-built plugin; functional evidence, not production configuration guidance.
Real providers, operator trust roots and release signatures remain unpassed; real settlement remains disabled.
